meta.title: Online order lifecycle
meta.description: The states an online shop order moves through, from checkout to delivery, and the side roads to cancellation, returns and refunds.

summary.headline: An order moves forward on warehouse and carrier events; every way out after payment ends in a refund, never a silent cancel.
points: A declined payment cancels the order before any stock is touched.
Cancelling after payment but before packing refunds at once.
Carrier tracking scans keep the order in Shipped without changing its state.
A return is refunded only after the parcel arrives and passes inspection.

facts.States: 8 plus a payment check, start and end

data.title: Placed
data.subtitle: Stock reserved
data.description: Stock is reserved for 20 minutes while the payment is authorised.

data.title: Payment authorised?
data.description: The payment provider's answer: authorised, or declined after 3-D Secure or a fraud check.

data.title: Packed
data.subtitle: Label printed
data.description: Picked, packed and weighed; the carrier label and the payment capture happen here.

data.title: Shipped
data.subtitle: With the carrier
data.description: Tracking scans update the delivery estimate shown to the customer.

data.title: Return requested
data.subtitle: Parcel on its way back
data.description: The customer has a prepaid label. The warehouse inspects the item when it arrives, before any money goes back.

data.title: Refunded
data.subtitle: Money sent back
data.description: Refunded to the original card; the bank shows it within 3 to 5 working days.

data.title: Cancelled
data.subtitle: Nothing charged
data.description: The stock reservation is released and the customer is emailed.

data.title: Closed
data.description: The order is archived for seven years for accounting.

steps.title: Overview
steps.description: The main road runs from Placed to Delivered. The rose states are the side roads: a cancelled order charges nothing, and every other way out after payment ends in a refund.

steps.title: Checkout and payment
steps.description: Placing the order reserves the stock. The payment result decides: authorised orders become Paid, declined ones are cancelled and the stock goes back on sale.

steps.title: Warehouse and carrier
steps.description: The warehouse picks and packs the order, and the payment is captured when the label prints. Once the carrier collects it, tracking scans loop on Shipped until the delivery scan.

steps.title: Returns
steps.description: Within 30 days the customer can ask for a return and gets a prepaid label. The refund is issued only when the parcel is back and passes inspection.

steps.title: Refunds before delivery
steps.description: A customer may cancel a paid order until it is packed, and a parcel the carrier loses is refunded too. Both skip the return steps.

steps.title: Closing the order
steps.description: A delivered order closes when the return window ends; refunded and cancelled orders close at once.
